name: Mama no Okugai Shuuchi Lesson ~Shisen ga Kairaku ni Kawaru Toki...~
original_name: ママの屋外羞恥レッスン ～視線が快楽に変る時…～
source:
My name is Miyase Shingo. A very ordinary guy, just like any other guy. Well, maybe I'm just ordinary?
My mom, Rio, puts her own issues aside and bluntly pushes her own theories of truth onto me.
She's a self-centered, self-proclaimed, perfect mother who prioritizes her own appearance over mine.
My dad, Makoto, is a man on the fast track to becoming an elite, wearing the mask of a perfect father.
He forces his self-proclaimed perfect self on me, a shallow, superficial image.

We have two worthless hypocrites in our family. Can you understand? 
Today, once again, Mom is angry with me and comforting herself. But it's so unreasonable... she's taking out her anger on me, so to speak...
I was so annoyed that I instinctively punched the wall. Naturally, Mom went crazy.
Just as I was thinking this was getting annoying, a piece of paper fell to the ground. Maybe it was on the dresser, but I picked it up.
In front of me, Mom became even more heated. But that didn't matter.
That piece of paper was a gift from heaven that would help me. A chance to turn things around.
It was a photo. It showed Mom when she was young.
And she was outside, completely naked...

With this, I would destroy everything. I would make her regret raising me like this.
And so I confronted Mom with the photo...

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=728430]Getchu[/url]]
